_note: Android image options assessed for upstream QEMU virt + HVF on M1 (2026-09-28).

direct_gsi.reason: GSI = system.img only; standalone boot on plain virt needs a self-built Android board (kernel+ramdisk+vendor+DTB+fstab+AVB). = §27 STOP condition.

reference_toolkit.confirms: On Apple Silicon + upstream QEMU, the practical Android path is Waydroid/Redroid INSIDE an ARM64 Linux guest (virt board). Cuttlefish-on-macOS-QEMU hangs (no host services); Google emu images need ranchu; standalone GSI = self-build only.

recommended_path: Redroid (or Waydroid) inside an ARM64 Linux guest booted on upstream qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt -accel hvf. Guest kernel needs CONFIG_ANDROID_BINDER_IPC + binderfs (Ubuntu/Debian arm64 ship it in linux-modules-extra) + docker.
